name: Apollo 11 Eagle

parts.name: Ascent stage
parts.role: Crew cabin and ascent engine that returned the crew to orbit
parts.snap: Ascent stage fitted. The habitat for Tranquility Base.

parts.name: Descent stage
parts.role: Octagonal structure housing the throttleable descent engine

parts.name: Landing legs
parts.role: Four deployable truss legs with crushable honeycomb footpads

parts.name: Ladder
parts.role: Attached to the forward leg for egress onto the lunar surface
parts.snap: Ladder affixed to the forward strut.

parts.name: S-band antenna
parts.role: Steerable parabolic dish for communications and television back to Earth

parts.name: Commemorative plaque
parts.role: Stainless steel plaque mounted between the ladder rungs
parts.snap: Plaque mounted: 'We came in peace for all mankind.'

challenge.title: Steer past the boulder field
challenge.intro: The computer is heading straight for a boulder-strewn crater. Steer horizontally to find a smooth clearing before fuel runs out.
challenge.hint: Use arrow keys or buttons to navigate left or right towards the green clear zone.

signal_note: Eagle's descent stage still rests at Tranquility Base; the ascent stage was discarded after crew transfer.
ending: Tranquility Base marked humanity's first footsteps on another celestial body.
